{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT – GREENCHOICE ECO COMPARISON WEBSITE (STATIC ONLY)

Create a professional, modern, fully responsive static website for an environmental comparison platform called GreenChoice Guide. The goal is to help visitors compare eco-friendly household products and sustainable lifestyle options in a clear, trustworthy, YouTube-inspired layout. This is NOT an ecommerce store and NOT a live data app. Use only static/mock/sample content inside the front-end.

TECH REQUIREMENTS
- Build with React + Tailwind CSS
- Static front-end only, no backend, no database, no login, no real API calls
- All product data, ratings, rankings, charts, comments, and articles should be hardcoded/mock data
- Must render as a static marketing/comparison website
- Use smooth page transitions between views/sections
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Professional environmental brand style, clean and credible
- Inspired by YouTube layout patterns: left category sidebar on desktop, video/card grid feeling, sticky top navigation, thumbnail-style comparison cards, tabs, chips, and recommendation sections

BRAND STYLE
Name: GreenChoice Guide
Tagline: Compare smarter. Waste less.
Tone: professional, helpful, factual, optimistic
Colors:
- Deep forest green
- Fresh leaf green
- Off-white / warm white
- Charcoal text
- Soft sky blue accents
- Light beige cards
Visual style:
- Clean cards
- Rounded corners
- Subtle shadows
- Smooth hover animations
- Environmental icons
- Product thumbnails using placeholders/gradients if images are not available
- Avoid cartoonish look; keep it credible and editorial

MAIN WEBSITE STRUCTURE
1. Home / Landing Page
2. Compare Products
3. Rankings
4. Guides
5. Impact Score Methodology
6. About
7. Contact / Newsletter mock section

NAVIGATION
Top navbar:
- Logo GreenChoice Guide
- Search bar placeholder: “Search reusable bottles, detergents, compost bins...”
- Links: Compare, Rankings, Guides, Methodology, About
- CTA button: “Start Comparing”

Desktop layout should include a left sidebar similar to YouTube category navigation:
- All Eco Picks
- Kitchen
- Cleaning
- Personal Care
- Energy Saving
- Low Waste
- Reusables
- Beginner Friendly
- Budget Picks
- Premium Picks

Mobile layout:
- Top hamburger/menu style or horizontal category chips
- Cards stack cleanly
- Keep CTA visible

PAGE TRANSITIONS / INTERACTIONS
- Use smooth fade/slide transitions when navigating sections/pages
- Cards should animate slightly on hover
- Comparison table rows can highlight on hover
- Tabs for categories should transition smoothly
- Product detail overlays or modal-like static panels are allowed, but no backend logic
- Search can be visual only or filter local mock data if simple; no external services

HOME PAGE DETAILS
Hero Section:
Headline: “Find the greener choice before you buy.”
Subheadline: “Compare everyday products by sustainability, cost, durability, packaging, and real-life usability — all in one clean guide.”
CTA buttons:
- “Compare Products”
- “View Top Rankings”
Hero visual:
- Large comparison dashboard preview with 3 featured product cards
- Include badges like “Low Waste”, “Plastic-Free”, “Best Value”, “Long Lasting”
- Add a small trust strip: “Static sample scores • Transparent criteria • No sponsored ranking shown”

Featured Comparison Section:
Title: “Popular comparisons this week”
Use YouTube-style thumbnail cards with category labels:
- Bamboo Toothbrush vs Recycled Plastic Toothbrush
- Reusable Water Bottle vs Boxed Water
- Eco Laundry Sheets vs Liquid Detergent
- Compostable Trash Bags vs Recycled Trash Bags
Each card should include:
- Thumbnail style visual
- Short title
- Mini score bars
- Estimated CO2 impact badge
- Read time like “4 min compare”

Category Rows like YouTube shelves:
- Best for Beginners
- Budget Eco Swaps
- Lowest Packaging Waste
- Top Rated Long-Life Products
Each row should have scrollable/card grid styling.

COMPARE PRODUCTS PAGE
Create a professional comparison interface with mock data.
Include:
- Page title: “Compare Eco Products Side by Side”
- Filter chips: Category, Price Range, Plastic-Free, Refillable, Certified, Locally Made, Durable
- Static comparison table with at least 5 products:
  1. EverLeaf Laundry Sheets
  2. ClearCycle Glass Cleaner Tabs
  3. TerraSip Stainless Bottle
  4. RootKind Bamboo Brush
  5. LoopNest Compost Bin
Comparison columns:
- Product
- Category
- Eco Score
- Price Level
- Packaging
- Durability
- Best For
- Drawback
- Overall Verdict
Use visual score bars and colored badges.

Add a “Compare Selected” area with 2 highlighted products side by side:
- Overall winner
- Best budget choice
- Best low-waste choice
- Best long-term value
This can be static, no need for real selection logic unless simple local UI.

RANKINGS PAGE
Create ranking cards with YouTube-style thumbnails and list ranking numbers.
Sections:
- Top 10 Low-Waste Kitchen Products
- Best Eco Cleaning Products
- Best Reusable Everyday Items
- Best Sustainable Starter Kit
Each ranking item should show:
- Rank number
- Mock product image/thumbnail
- Eco Score
- Pros
- Cons
- “Why it ranks here” text

Include a featured ranking block:
“2026 GreenChoice Starter Pack”
Products:
- Reusable bottle
- Laundry sheets
- Refillable cleaner tabs
- Bamboo toothbrush
- Compost bin
- Beeswax wraps
Make it look like a curated playlist/collection.

GUIDES PAGE
Editorial guide layout, like a YouTube education channel mixed with a magazine.
Guide cards:
- “How to read eco labels without getting confused”
- “Plastic-free vs recyclable: what matters more?”
- “The beginner’s guide to reducing household waste”
- “When reusable products are actually worth it”
- “Greenwashing red flags to watch for”
Each guide card should include:
- Thumbnail visual
- Category chip
- Short excerpt
- Reading time
- Author placeholder like “GreenChoice Editorial Team”

Add a featured guide hero:
“Stop buying ‘eco’ products blindly.”
Subtitle: “Use our simple scorecard to compare claims, materials, packaging, lifespan, and disposal.”

IMPACT SCORE METHODOLOGY PAGE
This page must look professional and transparent.
Explain the GreenChoice Score with static content.
Score categories:
- Materials: 25%
- Packaging: 20%
- Durability: 20%
- End-of-life / recyclability: 15%
- Everyday usability: 10%
- Cost efficiency: 10%
Include visual progress bars or donut-style CSS elements (no canvas required).
Add example scoring breakdown for “Eco Laundry Sheets”.
Add disclaimer:
“All scores shown are sample editorial scores for demonstration purposes and do not represent live certification data.”

ABOUT PAGE
Include:
- Mission statement
- Why comparison matters
- Editorial principles
- No greenwashing promise
- Static team cards with names/roles:
  - Maya Chen – Sustainability Research
  - Daniel Brooks – Product Comparison Editor
  - Sofia Patel – Waste Reduction Writer
  - Noah Evans – Visual Research
Keep it professional, not too corporate.

CONTACT / NEWSLETTER SECTION
Static contact area only.
Include:
- “Suggest a product to compare” form mockup
- Name, Email, Product/Topic fields
- Submit button can be non-functional or show simple front-end-only thank you state
- Newsletter box: “Get monthly low-waste comparison guides”
No real email sending, no backend.

DESIGN DETAILS
- Use Tailwind utility classes
- Components should be organized cleanly
- Include reusable components like Navbar, Sidebar, ProductCard, ComparisonTable, RankingCard, GuideCard, ScoreBadge, Footer
- Use realistic placeholder content
- Make the website feel finished and polished, not like a wireframe
- Add footer with columns:
  - Compare
  - Guides
  - Methodology
  - Green Living
  - Disclaimer
- Footer disclaimer: “GreenChoice Guide is a static demo website using sample content.”

CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
Use realistic but fictional product names and environmental claims. Do not use real API data. Include enough sample data so the pages look populated. Use professional copywriting, short paragraphs, clear headings, and useful comparison language.

IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS
- No login/account/admin
- No cart/checkout/payment
- No real product purchase links required
- No backend/server/database
- No live data, no external API
- No maps, no realtime data
- No 3D, no WebGL, no game mechanics
- Static website only with mock content

FINAL QUALITY EXPECTATION
The result should feel like a real environmental comparison marketing site that could be presented to users. It should have a polished homepage, functional-looking comparison sections, smooth transitions, responsive design, and a YouTube-inspired browsing experience while staying clean, professional, and static.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.
